meta.name: orca-cli
meta.description: Operate Orca-managed worktrees, folder contexts, terminals, repos, automations, artifacts, skill sharing, worktree comments, and Orca's embedded browser through the `orca` CLI. Use when the user says "$orca-cli", "Orca worktree", "child worktree", "spawn codex/claude in a worktree", "read/wait/send Orca terminal", "handoff" / "handover" / "give this to another agent", "Orca browser", "orca artifacts", or "share skills". Prefer it over raw git worktree, ad hoc PTYs, or Computer Use when Orca state is involved. Use Computer Use only when a visible window needs GUI control that a CLI, filesystem, or API cannot do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把编码任务放进独立工作区,让多个助手并行推进并互相交接
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果同时用多个编码助手,想让他们分工又方便交接
copy.tagline_en: Run coding tasks in isolated workspaces and hand them off between assistants
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you juggle several coding assistants and want them to split work and hand off

howto.what: Claude 会先确定本次会话该用哪个 orca 可执行文件,再运行 `skills get orca-cli` 拉取与该版本匹配的指南,之后按指南操作 Orca 管理的 worktree、终端、浏览器等。
howto.when: 当你提到 “$orca-cli”、“Orca worktree”、“handoff” 等关键词,或涉及 Orca 管理的状态时触发;原文写明此时优先用它,而不是原生 git worktree 或临时 PTY。

say.text: 用 orca-cli 加载本次会话对应的 Orca 指南
在 Orca 里给我开一个子 worktree,并在里面跑 claude
say.note: 按指南用 orca CLI 创建并启动

say.text: $orca-cli,把这件事交接给另一个 agent

howto.what_en: Claude first resolves which orca executable this session should use, runs `skills get orca-cli` to load the version-matched guide, then follows that guide to operate Orca-managed worktrees, terminals, repos, artifacts, and the embedded browser.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "$orca-cli", "Orca worktree", "handoff" etc., or when Orca-managed state is involved; preferred over raw git worktree, ad hoc PTYs, or Computer Use.

say_en.text: Load the Orca guide matched to this session
Spawn a child worktree in Orca and run claude inside it
say_en.note: Creates and starts it via the orca CLI

say_en.text: $orca-cli, hand this off to another agent
